title: Grateful Dead Live at Scope on 1982-04-03

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show with a scorching Scarlet → Fire transition and solid Peggy‑O, captured on a patchy matrix (soundboard + audience) recording that’s fair but listenable.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the explosive Scarlet > Fire segue, Jerry’s vocal inflection and guitar licks on Peggy‑O, and strong piano work from Brent. The performance is described as cohesive, exploratory and “hot,” while the recording is a mixed‑source (mostly audience with soundboard patches) that sounds muddy yet remains enjoyable for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars praising the musical performance; recording quality is noted as imperfect but acceptable, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly audience tape with patched soundboard sections; audible hiss and occasional mud, but key moments (Scarlet‑Fire, Peggy‑O) are clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, highlighted by the seamless Scarlet‑Fire transition and strong closing jams; overall performance is cohesive and exploratory.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal inflection on Scarlet and guitar licks in Peggy-O are repeatedly praised; his tone and phrasing are described as “scorching.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Only a brief note about a stage‑position change with Jerry, no specific playing comments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s piano is highlighted – more focused grand‑piano work, especially on the Estimated > Eyes outro.
